author: reek
body: Regression guard for LinearOwnership stage 1: freeze must stay polymorphic now that LinearTy survives type resolution. The parameterize walk recurses through the wrapper (a under linear becomes a bound TypeVar), instantiation freshens it, and unify strips it - so one freeze serves Integer and Text in one program. The old seed passes this too (erasure made it trivially true); the guard exists so no later stage silently monomorphizes it.
